{"content": "1|def transform(grid):
2|    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
3|    from collections import Counter
4|    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
5|    # Copy the repeated motif at every isolated singleton cell using motif's shape.
6|    seen=set();comps=[]
7|    for r in range(h):
8|        for c in range(w):
9|            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
10|            q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c));co=[]
11|            while q:
12|                y,x=q.pop();co.append((y,x,grid[y][x]))
13|                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
14|                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
15|                        seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
16|            comps.append(co)
17|    motif=max((co for co in comps if len(co)>1),key=len)
18|    ar=(min(r for r,c,v in motif)+max(r for r,c,v in motif))//2
19|    ac=(min(c for r,c,v in motif)+max(c for r,c,v in motif))//2
20|    offsets=[(r-ar,c-ac,v) for r,c,v in motif]
21|    anchors=[co[0][:2] for co in comps if len(co)==1]
22|    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
23|    for r,c in anchors:
24|        for dr,dc,v in offsets:
25|            y,x=r+dr,c+dc
26|            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w:
